title: Functional invariance of hidden activation View symmetries
hypothesis: At the layer-3 Pythia-70M MLP expansion, any invertible coordinate transform applied after GELU and compensated by the inverse down-projection is a representation gauge: model logits remain invariant within numerical tolerance and no logical functions are added. Uncompensated transforms change outputs and therefore cannot be counted as equivalent Views.
physical_object: Pinned Pythia-70M-deduped shared model and layer-3 MLP down-projection.
mirror_coordinate: Invertible address m on the 2048D post-GELU MLP activation; paired reparameterization replaces z by Mz and W_down by W_down M^-1.
logical_multiplicity: K coordinate encodings of one function if compensated; count distinct logits only when function behavior changes.
controls: Compensated monomial activation View (permutation, sign, positive scale) plus inverse down-projection
Compensated dense orthogonal activation View plus inverse down-projection
Uncompensated monomial activation transform (negative functional control)
Independent checkpoint byte upper: K copies of actual pinned model file bytes

task.source: Fixed relation input/output prompts from MA-530 task harness; values are only neutral language prompts, not learned labels.
task.primary_metric: max absolute next-token logit difference between canonical and compensated view
secondary_metrics: serialized code bytes for K=16 monomial views and K=16 dense-orthogonal views
monomial/dense transform and compensation operation proxies

transforms.monomial: Seeded random permutations, independent ±1 signs, and positive log-uniform scales in [0.5,2]; 16 views per world. Apply after GELU and pair inverse in the layer-3 dense_4h_to_h projection.
transforms.dense_orthogonal: One dense signed/permuted normalized Hadamard basis per world, reconstructed from its row/column permutations and signs; apply z @ Q^T and pair W_down @ Q^-1. One dense address per world.
transforms.negative_control: Apply the same monomial activation coordinate change but keep canonical down-projection; outputs are expected to differ.
transforms.numeric_gate: For every compensated view: max absolute logit delta <=1e-5 and top-1 agreement 100%. Report KL; never interpret equivalent addresses as distinct capacity.

development.selection_metric: No tuning; characterize exact invariant and numeric threshold.

fresh.opening_rule: Open after code and protocol commit; the algebra and transform families are fixed, no hyperparameter selection.

storage.authority: Actual uncompressed NPZ inference payload bytes.
paid_objects: canonical model files for shared deployment
all monomial permutations, signs and scales
dense orthogonal Hadamard row/column permutations and signs needed for deterministic reconstruction
storage.reporting: Report view-state bytes separately and combined with one pinned model; compare K independent model payloads using actual model file bytes.

compute.active_compute_proxy: Report transformed activation elements; monomial gathers/scales and compensation column gathers/scales; dense Q activation MACs and W_down compensation MACs; baseline/view forward seconds.

success_gate: On both dev and all three fresh worlds, all 16 compensated monomial addresses and the one compensated dense orthogonal address stay within max logit delta 1e-5 and have 100% top-1 agreement. Actual code payload and K-copy upper are reported. This is an invariance result, not a capacity success.
failure_gate: Any compensated family exceeds the output tolerance or changes top-1 predictions on any world; or artifact/split/replay integrity fails.
boundaries: One Pythia-70M model, one layer, one MLP expansion interface.
No task training or capacity claim.
The coordinate transform is paired with its inverse before hidden output returns to residual stream.
Uncompensated outputs are a changed function, not proof of useful specialization.
Results do not establish every activation-space view is a symmetry.
